notes: GeoTalk 1.2: Three fixes plus a call-engine upgrade. (1) The update popup no longer appears after you have already updated — the app now compares against its real installed version. (2) Incoming calls now RING with your default ringtone and vibration (internet and Bluetooth calls) until you answer or the call ends. (3) Problem reports are fixed: the newest incident is always recorded (an old report can no longer hide a new problem), the launch report dialog has a Clear button and shows each incident only once, and the update popup never stacks on top of it. The voice-call engine was also upgraded (newer WebRTC library + one shared call factory) to attack the app-closing problem at call start directly. Everything else is kept: near-instant call ringing and setup, direct phone-to-phone WebRTC voice first, Cloudflare TURN relay (UDP, TCP and TLS 443) when a network blocks the direct path, Push-to-Talk as the final fallback, plus internet and Bluetooth chat + voice calls, voice messages and in-app updates.
